note: Claude-drawn stand-ins for open requests in docs/ART_REQUESTS.md, generated by scripts/build-claude-standins.mjs from the area modules in scripts/claude-art/areas/ and the SVGs in svg/<module>/. Temporary: not Astra’s art. A frame or clip of the same name in frontier-v1 wins over one listed here, so registering her delivery replaces the stand-in; then delete its entry in the area module and rerun the script. x/y/w/h are pixels in the named sheet; anchorX/anchorY the ground contact; logicalHeight, where present, the height a frame is scaled to (public/art.js), as in her people sheets.
